benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft on most rental cars, as a Visa Signature cardholder benefit.
benefits.terms: Secondary coverage — requires filing a claim with your primary auto insurance first. Decline the rental company's collision coverage to activate.

benefits.name: Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $250,000 in travel accident coverage when the entire common carrier fare is charged to the card.
benefits.terms: Visa Signature cardholder benefit. Covers cardholder and dependents on common carrier travel (e.g. airline, train, bus, ship) paid for with the card.

benefits.name: Purchase Security
benefits.description: Reimbursement for eligible items that are stolen or accidentally damaged within 90 days of purchase.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Doubles the manufacturer's warranty on eligible purchases (up to an additional year).

benefits.name: Visa Signature Concierge
benefits.description: Complimentary concierge service for travel planning, dining reservations, entertainment tickets, and more.

benefits.name: Personal Identity Theft Protection
benefits.description: Visa Signature identity theft resolution assistance for cardholders.

earningRates.terms: 2.5% cash back on up to $10,000 in purchases per billing cycle requires an open Alliant High-Rate Checking account; drops to 1.5% above the cap or without the qualifying checking account.
Unlimited 1.5% cash back on all purchases without a qualifying Alliant High-Rate Checking account, or on spend above the $10,000/billing-cycle cap.
